title: OpenAI's revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
summary: FT reported that OpenAI's annualized revenue is ~$50B at September end, vs ~$70B previously circulated. The $20B gap reflects accounting methodology (gross vs net). Oracle fell ~5% and CoreWeave fell ~8% on Oct 8; broader AI stocks broadly recovered Oct 9 as markets concluded the gap was a measurement difference, not a demand slowdown.
why: OpenAI是全球AI算力最大需求方，收入预期下修短期引发AI基础设施板块卖盘，波及英伟达、腾讯等AI投入重仓股；但一日内快速收复说明市场判断为会计口径差异而非需求减速。持AI相关sell-put标的者需关注隐含波动率回落对vega收益的影响。

title: Oil prices stable as market weighs supply risks, rising Middle East exports
summary: Brent crude eased to ~$103/bbl on Oct 9 as Iran-US 'productive discussions' tempered fears, though tanker flows remain at ~90% of pre-war levels. EIA's October STEO raised Q4 2026 Brent forecast to average $105/bbl; the Sep 15 Saudi pipeline attack had briefly sent Brent to $131/bbl. A planned G7 strategic stock release was also reported.
why: 油价高企持续推升通胀预期，强化美联储维持高利率的立场；对高估值科技/消费成长股的估值压力较大。若油价再度飙升（沙特管道被攻击等风险）将冲击持仓组合；伊朗谈判进展值得持续追踪，有助于判断期权行权价设置方向。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rally to cap volatile week as earnings season nears
summary: US stocks closed higher Oct 9: Dow +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.6%. All three major averages posted weekly gains, recovering from the AI-driven selloff earlier in the week. Big bank earnings season kicks off next week with results from JPMorgan, Goldman, Wells Fargo and others.
why: 美股在AI卖压中全面收复失地并周度收涨，说明市场情绪短期稳定；大型银行财报季下周启动，将为市场定下Q3盈利基调，影响整体风险偏好，对sell-put策略的delta/vega管理有直接指引意义。

title: 港股热点：恒科指大涨约3%，小米涨9.72%，阿里领涨，A股午后V形反攻
summary: 10月9日港股强劲反弹：恒生科技指数约涨3%，小米（1810.HK）+9.72%报25.96港元，阿里巴巴（9988.HK）涨约3.5%，科技与金融双轮驱动；恒生指数收24211点+1.79%。A股午后上演V形反弹，上证综指微涨0.05%收3813.79点，创业板指+0.22%。恒指夜期10月10日高水152点。
why: 港股/A股同步消化AI卖盘冲击并快速反弹，科技主线未受伤及。小米大涨直接利好持仓；A股午后由券商领涨，资金仍对估值修复有信心。恒指夜期高水暗示本周末前维持较积极情绪，有利于持put卖出方。

title: PBOC plans large liquidity injection via buyout reverse repos after Golden Week holiday
summary: Following China's Golden Week national holiday (Oct 1-7), the PBOC announced a large-scale buyout reverse repo operation on Oct 8-9, injecting approximately 1.1-1.2 trillion yuan in 3-month tenor funding to maintain ample banking system liquidity. The central bank reiterated its 'appropriately loose' monetary policy stance and opposition to competitive currency depreciation.
why: 节后央行大额注水维稳流动性，是支撑A股/港股午后反弹的重要宏观背景；人民银行继续宽松立场对估值修复有利，降低了持有港股/A股的机会成本，有助于sell-put策略的实施环境。

title: 传腾讯筹谋发行最高500亿港元离岸债券加码AI投入
summary: 据格隆汇援引彭博消息，腾讯正考虑发行离岸债券，规模最高约50亿美元（约390亿港元），可能以美元和离岸人民币计价，最早或于10月内发行。腾讯6月已完成近47亿美元离岸发债，目前境外未偿债券约220亿美元。今年已在AI项目与算力的资本开支同比增逾176%。腾讯尚未置评。
why: 腾讯再融资规模若落地，意味着AI军备竞赛中资本开支将进一步扩大，对短期自由现金流有压力，可能影响回购节奏及分红能力；另一方面，若成功发行说明海外投资者对腾讯信用背书仍强，有助于修复情绪。期权卖方需重新评估腾讯资本结构变化对远期EPS及行权价设定的影响。

title: US market update: Dow rises 423 points, Alibaba (BABA) surges 5.36%
summary: Alibaba Group (BABA) surged 5.36% on Oct 9, among the strongest performers in a broadly higher US market session. CICC maintained its Outperform rating with a HK$172 target, citing rapid growth in Alibaba Cloud revenue and profit with positive free cash flow. YTD the stock is still down ~24% amid heavy AI capex investments.
why: 阿里巴巴是中概股代表性标的；+5.36%单日涨幅说明市场情绪已从OpenAI收入担忧中恢复，云业务盈利能力受认可。中信证券HK$172目标意味着港股对应目前有上行空间；但YTD下跌24%的背景下，卖put者需关注后续财报（11月预计）是否验证云业务改善。

title: SK Hynix ADR lockup expiry stirs anxiety over bumper ADR premium
summary: SK Hynix's 90-day lockup on its US-listed ADRs (ticker: SKHY) expired Oct 8, 2026. The ADRs, which raised $26.5B at $149 in July 9's IPO, have been trading at approximately 38% premium over its Korean-listed shares. Conversion is capped at 2.5% of total shares outstanding, which analysts say may prevent the premium from collapsing quickly. Seoul shares fell 2.8% on Oct 9 despite AMD's endorsement of multi-generational HBM cooperation.
why: SK Hynix ADR锁定期到期是重要技术面事件，38%溢价和有限转换机制决定套利空间受限，但增加了美股端的波动风险；AMD背书多代HBM合作但未附具体条款，市场反应偏谨慎。南方两倍做多海力士ETF持有者需重点关注此期权到期是否触发异常波动，以及HBM4市场份额数据（三星份额Q2升至33%、SK Hynix降至30%）对估值逻辑的影响。

title: The GENIUS Act Compliance Deadline: Treasury's October 19 Window
summary: Treasury's GENIUS Act NPRM (docket TREAS-DO-2026-0496) has an October 19, 2026 comment deadline — the last window for industry to shape final stablecoin rules before the January 18, 2027 enforcement date. The Act bars stablecoin holders from earning yield. Circle's USDC hit $74.1B in circulation (vs $74.3B reserves) as of Oct 5. On Oct 7, Circle announced USDC/EURC integration into SAP enterprise payments.
why: GENIUS Act最终规则将决定Circle（CRCL）的商业模式边界和分发成本结构；禁止付息规定直接影响Coinbase对USDC持有者提供的3.6%年化收益安排。Oct 19评论截止是关键节点，规则走向影响整个稳定币赛道估值，与Circle持仓的option定价密切相关。SAP整合是B2B支付场景拓展的里程碑式进展。
